subject: Planned safeguard rollout: regional rolling restarts (minimal impact) — customer prep & confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: ops@datasolutions.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Planned safeguard rollout: regional rolling restarts (minimal impact) — customer prep

Hello —

We are planning a short, staggered maintenance window for the us-east3 region to apply a kernel/driver hardening patch and run rolling restarts across host pools. This is a precautionary "safeguard rollout" intended to improve IO stability and reduce rare KV-cache corruption we observed in a small subset of long-running jobs.

Window (staggered across availability pools):
- Start: Tue, 18 May 2027 00:30 UTC
- End: Thu, 20 May 2027 06:00 UTC (work will be staged; your resources may be touched for a few minutes during a pool-level restart)

What to expect:
- We expect minimal customer-facing disruption. Most requests will continue to route to healthy pools.
- Long-running streaming/inference jobs and large batched jobs may see brief reconnects (seconds) when a host is drained.
- If we detect error spikes for a customer, automatic fallback routing to a compatible model variant will be applied.

Action items for customers (recommended):
1) If you have scheduled heavy batch runs between 00:00–04:00 UTC on 18–19 May, consider moving them outside the window or lowering batch size.
2) Pin model versions for critical endpoints if you want to avoid automatic model switches during the window.
3) If you rely on persistent KV-warm caches, send a quick pre-warm (a few short inference calls) after your pool's restart window.

Attachments: customer-preflight-checklist.csv (quick checklist), safeguard-rollout-plan.pdf (detailed schedule and rollback runbook).

SRE escalation: if you see sustained errors, please open a ticket with priority "maintenance-impact" or call the on-call SRE at +1-555-0142. For this rollout I am the primary contact: marissa.cole@redwood.ai (cc'ed).

We will post live progress updates to the status page and a short postmortem after the window.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

On Mon, 17 May 2027 at 15:22 Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We are planning a short, staggered maintenance window for the us-east3 region ...

Marissa / Lina —

We can mitigate customer impact for DataSolutions by:
- Applying a temporary sticky-route exception for their critical endpoints during the 01:00–04:00 UTC window so requests prefer nodes we drain last.
- Enabling fallback to a smaller-compatible model variant automatically if we detect >2% error rate for >3 minutes.
- Asking them to shift the heavy batch to 03:00 UTC if possible; that gives us time to complete the first wave and reduce collision risk.

Lina, if shifting to 03:00 UTC is feasible for you we will mark their account as "reduced-impact" and notify infra to avoid draining their primary pool until after 02:45 UTC. If not, we can enable the sticky-route and fallback and monitor closely.

Ben

Subject: Completed: safeguard rollout in us-east3 — confirmation and postmortem link

Hi Lina —

The staged rolling restarts in us-east3 completed on 19 May without any sustained customer-facing failures. Summary:
- Start: 2027-05-18 00:30 UTC; end: 2027-05-19 08:14 UTC (your account's primary host pool was restarted on 2027-05-18 03:20 UTC).
- Observed: brief reconnects during host swaps (median reconnect < 6s), no persistent errors for your endpoints.
- Your nightly batch at 01:30 UTC was partially affected: one instance retried automatically and completed successfully; we saw no data loss.

Actions taken for DataSolutions (per Ben's note):
- We enabled the sticky-route exception and fallback policy for your critical endpoints during the window.
- Infra avoided draining your most-used host until after 02:45 UTC.

Attachments and links:
- postmortem-20270519.md (attached, short summary + metrics)
- Full postmortem: https://redwood.ops/postmortem/2027-05-19-safeguard-rollout
- Internal runbook/patch: https://drive.redwood.internal/safeguard-rollout/plan

If you saw any anomalies we missed, please reply and the SRE team will investigate with priority. We'll plan a short follow-up call next week if you'd like a deeper dive into the telemetry.

Thanks for being flexible — appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
